<p><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> Of all the content that was uploaded and removed for a TOS violation during the last six months of 2023, 96.95% of content was identified via Pornhub’s internal methods of moderation, compared to 3.04% of content being alerted to our team from our users.</em> </p>
<h3 id="h_01H9R3X4GMCZ1AAZ9NFT95AX1Z"><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">User-Initiated Removals</span></span></h3>
<p>While we endeavor to remove offending content before it is ever available on our platform, our users play an important role in alerting us to content that may violate our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a>. Users may bring this content to our attention by flagging content or submitting a content removal request. These features are available to prevent abuse on the platform, assist victims in quickly removing content, and to foster a safe environment for our adult community.</p>
<p>Users may alert us to content that may be illegal or otherwise violate our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a> by using the flagging feature found below all videos and photos, or by filling out our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/content-removal">Content Removal Request</a> form.  Flagging and Content Removal Requests are kept confidential, and we review all content that is brought to our attention by users through these means.</p>
<p>User-based removals accounted for 3.04% of all removals for content uploaded and removed in the last six months of 2023. After internal detection, user-based removals account for the largest percentage of removals overall, and specifically when identifying non-consensual content.</p>
<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-large"><strong>User Flags</strong></span></p>
<p class="MsoNoSpacing"><span style="font-size: 11.0pt;">Users may flag content to bring it to the attention of our moderation team for the following reasons: Potentially Features a Minor, Violent or Harmful Acts, Hateful or Inflammatory, Spam or Misleading Content or Otherwise Objectionable or Inappropriate. </span></p>
<p class="MsoNoSpacing"><span style="font-size: 11.0pt;">From July through December, content reported using the flagging feature was most often for “Violent or Harmful Acts” and “Otherwise Inappropriate or Objectionable”, which accounts for nearly 60% of flags. </span></p>
<p class="undefined"><span style="font-size: 11.0pt;"><img src="/hc/article_attachments/27611075502867" alt="Picture6.png"></span></p>
<p class="MsoNoSpacing"><em><span style="font-size: 9.0pt;">The figure above shows the breakdown of flagged videos received from users during the six month period ended December 31, 2023. </span></em></p>
<p class="MsoNoSpacing"><span style="font-size: 11.0pt;">Upon receiving flags on videos and other content, our moderation team reviews the content and removes it if it violates our Terms of Service. Of the content removed after being flagged, most were removed due to Community Guidelines violations. </span></p>
<p class="MsoNoSpacing"><span style="font-size: 11.0pt;">In addition to flagging content, users may also flag comments, users, and verified uploaders.</span></p>
<p class="undefined"><span style="font-size: 11.0pt;"><img src="/hc/article_attachments/27611106767251" alt="Picture7.png"></span></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing"><strong><em><span style="font-size: 9.0pt;">Analysis: </span></em></strong><em><span style="font-size: 9.0pt;">In the figure titled, “Videos Flagged by Reason”, the second largest category selected by users was “Otherwise Inappropriate or Objectionable”, which correlates to Community Guidelines violation. Community Guidelines violations accounted for nearly 35% of flagged videos that were removed. </span></em></p>
<p class="MsoNoSpacing"><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-large"><strong>Content Removal Requests</strong></span></p>
<p>Upon receipt of a Content Removal Request, the content is immediately suspended from public view pending investigation. This is an important step in assisting victims and addressing abusive content. All requests are reviewed by our moderation team, who work to ensure that any content that violates our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a> is quickly and permanently removed. In addition to being removed, abusive content is digitally fingerprinted with both Mediawise and Safeguard, to prevent re-upload. In accordance with our policies, uploaders of non-consensual content or potential CSAM will also be banned. All content identified as potential CSAM is reported to the <a href="https://www.missingkids.org/home">National Center for Missing and Exploited Children</a> (NCMEC).</p>
<p>During the last six months of 2023, Pornhub received a total of 5,125 Content Removal Requests.</p>

<p><span style="color: #111111; background-color: white;">Of the content removed due to Content Removal Requests, the majority was removed for Withdrawal of Consent. </span></p>

<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Combatting Child Sexual Abuse Material</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p><span style="color: #111111; background-color: white;">We have a </span><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419869793683-Child-Sexual-Abuse-Material-Policy">zero-tolerance policy</a><span style="color: #111111; background-color: white;"> against underage content, as well as the exploitation of minors in any capacity.</span></p>
<p style="background-color: white;"><span style="color: #111111;">Pornhub is against the creation and dissemination of child sexual abuse material (CSAM), as well as the abuse and trafficking of children. CSAM is one of many examples of illegal content that is prohibited by our </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a></span> <span style="color: #111111;">and related guidelines.</span></p>
<p style="background-color: white;"><span style="color: #111111;">Pornhub is proud to be one of the 1,400+ companies registered with the </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.missingkids.org/HOME" target="_self">National Center for Missing and Exploited Children</a></span><span style="color: #111111;"> (NCMEC) Electronic Service Provider (ESP) Program. We have made it a point to not only ensure our policies and moderation practices are aligned with global expectations on child exploitation, but also to publicly announce our commitment and support to continue to adhere to the </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.justice.gov/opa/press-release/file/1256061/download"><em><strong><span style="color: #ff9900;">Voluntary Principles to Counter Online Child Sexual Exploitation and Abuse</span></strong></em></a></span><span style="color: #111111;">.</span></p>
<p style="background-color: white;"><span style="color: #111111;">Potential child sexual abuse material that is detected through moderation efforts, including detection through various internal and external tools listed </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/19159382668435-Trust-and-Safety-Initiatives">here</a></span><span style="color: #111111;">, or reported to us by our users and other external sources is reported to NCMEC. For the purposes of our </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419869793683-Child-Sexual-Abuse-Material-Policy">CSAM Policy</a></span><span style="color: #111111;"> and our reporting to NCMEC, we deem a child to be a human, real or fictional, who is or appears to be below the age of 18. Any content that features a child engaged in sexually explicit conduct, lascivious or lewd exhibition is deemed CSAM for the purposes of our Child Sexual Abuse Material Policy.</span></p>

<p><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> Of all the content that was reported as potential CSAM during the six-month period ended December 31, 2023, including content uploaded prior to 2023, over 90% of content was identified via Pornhub’s internal methods of moderation, compared to 6.87% of content being alerted to our team from our users.</em> </p>

<p><span style="color: #111111;">Non-consensual content not only encompasses what is commonly referred to as “revenge pornography” or image-based abuse, but also includes any content which involves non-consensual act(s), the recording of sexual material without consent of the person(s) featured, or any content which uses a person’s likeness without their consent.  </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">We are steadfast in our commitment to protecting the safety of our users and the integrity of our platform; we stand with all victims of non-consensual content. </span></p>

<p><em>The above figure shows a breakdown of banned accounts based on the source of detection. In addition to internal and user-sourced removals, removals due to External Trusted Sources include legal requests and notifications from our </em><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419879221907-Pornhub-Trusted-Flagger-Program"><em>Trusted Flaggers</em></a><em>. </em></p>
<p><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> Of the accounts that were banned in the last six months of 2023, nearly 90% were identified due to internal detection methods, while user notifications accounted for 10.61% of banned accounts.  </em></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>DMCA</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p><span style="color: #111111; background-color: white;">The <em>Digital Millennium Copyright Protection Act</em>, known as the DMCA, is a U.S. law that limits the liability of online service providers for the copyright infringement caused by their users. To qualify, online service providers must do —and not do — certain things. The most well-known aspects of the DMCA are its requirements that a service provider remove materials after it receives a notice of infringement and have (and implement) a policy to deter repeat infringement. Pornhub promptly responds to requests relating to copyright notifications. </span></p>
<p>In addition to blocking uploads of works previously fingerprinted with Mediawise or Safeguard from appearing on Pornhub, during the six-month period ended December 31, 2023, we responded to <strong>1,418 </strong>requests for removal, leading to a total of <strong>2,523 </strong>pieces of content (2,369 videos and 154 photos) removed.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/27611653638547" alt="Picture18.png"></p>
<p><em>The above figure shows the number of requests for removal related to DMCA per month in the second half of 2023. </em></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Cooperation with Law Enforcement</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p>We cooperate with law enforcement globally and readily provide all information available to us upon request and receipt of appropriate documentation and authorization. Legal requests can be submitted by governments and law enforcement, as well as private parties.</p>
<p>In the second half of 2023, we responded to <strong>113 legal requests</strong>. A breakdown by request type as indicated by law enforcement is provided below. </p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/27611639582867" alt="Picture19.png" width="659" height="368"></p>
<p><em>The above figure displays the number of requests Pornhub received from law enforcement and legal entities in the last six months of 2023, broken down by the type of request as indicated by the requester. </em></p>
<p>As a result of these requests, we classified a total of <strong>10 pieces of content</strong> (all videos) as Terms of Service Violations due to legal requests. A breakdown by removal type is provided below. </p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/27611653658515" alt="Picture20.png" width="675" height="325"></p>
<p><em>The above figure displays content that was identified in law enforcement requests that we deemed to violate our Terms of Service upon review.  </em></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Content De-Indexing</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p>As part of our Trust and Safety efforts to remove abusive content not only from our platform, but globally, we request de-indexing of URLs that were removed for violating our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a> from search engines. We proactively seek to de-index all content that is removed for potential CSAM and non-consensual content.</p>
<p>In the second half of 2023, we requested de-indexing of <strong>7,109 </strong>URLs for 7,081 unique pieces of content.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/27611639609491" alt="Picture21.png"></p>
<p class="MsoNoSpacing"><em><span style="font-size: 9.0pt;">The above figure displays a breakdown of the reason for URLs that were de-indexed from search engines. There may be several URLs de-indexed per piece of content, as we request the de-indexing of every version of the URL (e.g. it.pornhub.com/123 would be a URL de-indexed for the content located at www.pornhub.com/123). </span></em></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

          <header class="article-header">
            <h1 class="article__title" itemprop="name">
              
              2023 Transparency Report (First Half)
            </h1>
            

            <div class="article-meta">
              <div class="article-meta__col article-meta__col--main">
                <div class="entry-info">
                  
                  
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </header>

          <div class="article__body markdown" itemprop="articleBody" data-article="">
            <p>For Pornhub, nothing is more important than the safety of our community. Upholding our Core Values of <strong>consent</strong><strong>, </strong><strong>freedom of sexual expression</strong><strong>, </strong><strong>authenticity</strong><strong>, </strong><strong>originality</strong><strong>, </strong>and <strong>diversity</strong> is only possible through the continual efforts to ensure the safety of our users and our platform. Consequently, we have always been committed to preventing and eliminating illegal content, including non-consensual material and child sexual abuse material (CSAM). Every online platform has the moral responsibility to join this fight, and it requires collective action and constant vigilance.</p>
<p>Over the years, we have put in place robust measures to protect our platform from abuse. We are constantly improving our Trust and Safety policies to better identify, flag, remove, review, and report illegal or abusive material. We are committed to doing all that we can to ensure a safe online experience for our users, which involves a concerted effort to innovate and always striving to do more.</p>
<p>As part of our efforts and dedication to Trust and Safety, we feel it is important to provide information about our Trust and Safety initiatives, technologies, moderation practices and how our platform responds to harmful content. This Transparency Report provides these insights and builds upon our previous reports. Further information can be found in other sections of our Trust and Safety Center, including <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/6017547823763-Pornhub-Literacy">resources</a> about our community, keeping our platform safe, and our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419900587155-About-our-Policies-and-Related-Guidelines">policies</a>.</p>
<p>We are committed to being as transparent as possible and to being a leader in eradicating abusive content from the internet. We will continue to do our part to create a safe space for our users.</p>
<div class="accordion accordion--default">
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Trust and Safety Initiatives and Partnerships - 2023 Mid-Year Update</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p>Our goal to achieve and set the highest level of Trust and Safety standards relies heavily on not only our internal policies and moderation team, but also on our array of external partnerships and technology. The organizations we partner with are part of the global effort to reduce illegal material online and help ensure our platform and adult users can feel safe.</p>
<p>We continued to further our Trust and Safety efforts and are proud to have added new partnerships and initiatives. Below is a non-exhaustive list of partnerships and accomplishments achieved in the first half of 2023:</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #111111;">IWF Partnership</span></strong></p>
<p>We continue to participate in our two-year pilot project in partnership with the <a href="https://www.iwf.org.uk/">Internet Watch Foundation</a> (IWF) to develop a model of good practice to support the adult industry in combatting child sexual abuse material online.</p>
<p>The project is being overseen by an external advisory board of experts who will guide the outputs of the partnership. <span style="color: #111111;">Key learnings from the project will be shared publicly to support others’ work in this area.</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #111111;">Trust and Safety Professional Association </span></strong></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">In 2023, we became members of the </span><a href="https://www.tspa.org/">Trust and Safety Professional Association</a><span style="color: #111111;"> (TSPA), an organization which works to serve as a global community for Trust and Safety teams and individuals. TSPA offers Trust and Safety teams the opportunity to collaborate and share information to assist in developing best practices related to Trust and Safety on online platforms. </span></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #111111;">Take It Down Service</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">We are a participant of the </span><a href="https://takeitdown.ncmec.org/">Take It Down</a><span style="color: #111111;"> service, which is operated by the </span><a href="https://www.missingkids.org/home">National Center for Missing and Exploited Children</a><span style="color: #111111;"> (NCMEC). This service allows individuals to fingerprint their own underage content to assist in the removal and prevention of this content from appearing on online platforms. </span></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #111111;">StopNCII </span></strong></p>

<h3 id="h_01H9R3X4GKN35VNTDSCRBKK7MG"><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Non-Consensual Content (NCC) </span></span></h3>
<p>In the first half of 2023, we removed <strong>4,449 </strong>pieces of content (3,232 videos and 1,217 photos) for violating our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419871787027-Non-Consensual-Content-Policy">NCC policy</a>. When we identify or are made aware of the existence of non-consensual content on Pornhub, we remove the content, fingerprint it to prevent re-upload, and ban the user in accordance with our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a>. </p>
<p>Our NCC policy includes the following violations:</p>
<ul>
<li>Non-Consensual Content – Act(s): Content which depicts activity for which an individual did not validly consent. A non-consensual act is one involving the application of force directly or indirectly without the consent of the other person to a sexual act. </li>
<li>Non-Consensual Content – Recording(s): The recording of sexually explicit activity without the consent of the featured person. </li>
<li>Non-Consensual Content – Distribution: The distribution of sexually explicit content without the featured person’s permission. </li>
<li>Non-Consensual Content – Manipulation: Also known as “deepfake,” this type of content appropriates a real person’s likeness without their consent. </li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_01H9R3X4GKMRB1JE9AFXS0Y7XP"><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Potential Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) </span></span></h3>
<p>We have a <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419869793683-Child-Sexual-Abuse-Material-Policy">zero-tolerance policy</a> toward any content that features a person (real or animated) that is under the age of 18. Through our use of cutting-edge CSAM detection technology, identity verification measures, as well as human moderators, we strive to quickly identify and remove potential CSAM and ban users who have uploaded this content. Any content that we identify as or are made aware of being potential CSAM is also fingerprinted to prevent re-upload upon removal. We report all instances of potential CSAM to the <a href="https://www.missingkids.org/">National Center for Missing and Exploited Children</a> (NCMEC).</p>
<p>In the first six months of 2023, we made <strong>1,214 </strong>reports to NCMEC. These reports contained 3,951 pieces of content (2,632 videos and 1,319 photos) which were reported for violating our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419869793683-Child-Sexual-Abuse-Material-Policy">CSAM Policy</a>.</p>
<h3 id="h_01H9R3X4GKPN16MTVH01WM0350"><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Community Guidelines Violations</span></span></h3>
<p>In the first half of 2023, we removed <strong>80,021 </strong>pieces of content (40,007 videos and 40,014 photos) for violating our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419900587155-Community-Guidelines">Community Guidelines</a>. When we identify or are made aware of the existence of content that violates our Community Guidelines on Pornhub, we remove the content, fingerprint it to prevent re-upload, and, where appropriate, may ban the user.  <a name="_Hlk129094880"></a></p>
<p>A portion of these removals is related to requests from individuals who previously consented to the distribution of content they appear in but have submitted a request to retract that consent. Uploaders whose content is removed upon an individual retracting their consent for the content to be distributed are not subject to banning as per our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419871787027-Non-Consensual-Content-Policy">NCC policy</a>. Individuals who wish to retract their consent may reach out to us via our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/content-removal">Content Removal Request</a> form.</p>
<p>Content may be removed for Community Guidelines violations, outside of any of the other reasons listed, for being objectionable or inappropriate for our platform. This also includes violations related to brand safety, defamation, and the use of our platform for sexual services.</p>
<h3 id="h_01H9R3X4GMDAPW9TC06DT0Y9NT"><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Other Reasons for Removal</span></span></h3>

<p>We do not allow abusive or <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/14512634908819-Hate-Speech-Policy">hateful content</a> or comments of a racist, homophobic, transphobic, or otherwise derogatory nature intended to hurt or shame those individuals featured.</p>
<p>From January through June, we removed <strong>34 </strong>pieces of content (all videos) for violating our hate speech and violent speech policy.   </p>
<p><strong>Animal Guidelines</strong></p>
<p>Content that shows or promotes <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/7906741373971-Animal-Welfare-Policy">harmful activity to animals</a>, including exploiting an animal for sexual gratification, physical or psychological abuse of animals, is prohibited on our platform.</p>
<p>In the first six months of 2023, we removed <strong>197 </strong>pieces of content (187 videos and 10 photos) for violating our Animal Guidelines.   </p>
<p><strong>Bodily Fluids </strong></p>
<p>Content depicting vomit, or feces, among others, is not permitted on Pornhub.</p>
<p>In the first half of 2023, we removed <strong>1,691 </strong>pieces of content (1,660 videos and 31 photos) for violating our policy related to excretion of bodily fluids.   </p>
<p><strong>Familial Relations </strong></p>

<p>During the six month period ended June 30, 2023, we removed <strong>1,533 </strong>pieces of content (1,532 videos and 1 photo) for violating our policy related to familial relations.  </p>

<p>We prohibit excessive use of force that poses a risk of serious physical harm to any person appearing in the content or any physical or sexual activity with a corpse. This violation does not include forced sexual acts, as this content would fall under our non-consensual policy. </p>
<p>In the first six months of 2023, we removed <strong>545 </strong>pieces of content (530 videos and 15 photos) for violating our bodily harm and violent content policy.   </p>
<p><strong>Co-Performer Verification Incomplete </strong></p>
<p>We require uploaders to maintain valid documentation for any other individuals appearing in their content. We may remove content if verification for a co-performer is incomplete.</p>
<p>In the first half of 2023, we removed <strong>119,647</strong> pieces of content (116,894 videos and 2,753 photos) for having incomplete verification of the co-performers depicted.  </p>

<p>While users can notify us of potentially abusive content, we also invest a great deal into internal detection, which includes technology and a 24/7 team of moderators, who can detect content that may violate our Terms of Service at time of upload and before it is published. <p><span style="color: #111111;">Non-consensual content not only encompasses what is commonly referred to as “revenge pornography” or image-based abuse, but also includes any content which involves non-consensual act(s), the recording of sexual material without consent of the person(s) featured, or any content which uses a person’s likeness without their consent.  </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">We are steadfast in our commitment to protecting the safety of our users and the integrity of our platform; we stand with all victims of non-consensual content. </span></p>
<p>From January through June, we removed <strong>4,449 </strong>pieces of content (3,232 videos and 1,217 photos) for violating our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419871787027-Non-Consensual-Content-Policy">NCC policy</a>.  </p>
<p>For all content removed for violating our NCC policy in the first six months of 2023, the majority of this content was identified through users, at 79.34%.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/20448749523987" alt="Picture13.png"></p>
<p><em>The above figure shows a breakdown of NCC removals based on the source of detection. In addition to internal and user-sourced removals, removals due to External Trusted Sources include legal requests and notifications from our </em><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419879221907-Pornhub-Trusted-Flagger-Program"><em>Trusted Flaggers</em></a><em>. </em></p>
<p><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> Of all the content that was removed for violating our NCC policy in the first six months of 2023, including content uploaded prior to 2023, 17.76% of content was identified via Pornhub’s internal methods of moderation, compared to 79.34% of content being alerted to our team from our users.</em> </p>
<p>Most of the content uploaded in the first half of 2023 and removed for a violation of our NCC policy was identified through users, at 73.03%.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/20448749534867" alt="Picture14.png"></p>
<p><em>The above figure shows a breakdown of NCC removals that were uploaded during the six month period ended June 30, 2023, based on the source of detection. See above for further information about the sources of removal. </em></p>
<p><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> Of all the content that was uploaded and removed for violating our NCC policy during the first six months of 2023, 25.82% of content was identified via Pornhub’s internal methods of moderation, compared to nearly three quarters of content being alerted to our team from our users.</em></p>
<p><span style="color: black;">As part of our efforts to identify and quickly remove non-consensual content and other harmful material, we try to ensure this content is removed before it is available to users and consumers. Of videos both uploaded and removed for violating our NCC policy in 2023 from January through June, which represents 0.09% of uploads during this time, nearly 25% were removed before being viewed.  </span></p>
<p>Videos uploaded in the first six months of 2023 and removed for violating our NCC policy accounted for 0.07% of total views of all videos uploaded in the first half of 2023.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/20448763735443" alt="Picture15.png"></p>
<p><em>The above figure shows the number of times videos uploaded in the first six months of 2023 were viewed prior to being removed for violating our NCC policy. </em></p>
<p><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> <span style="color: black; background-color: white;">24.81% of videos were identified and removed by our human moderators or internal detection tools before going live on our platform. </span></em></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Banned Accounts</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p>As part of our efforts to ensure user and platform safety, we ban accounts that have committed serious or repeated violations of our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a>. Additionally, accounts that have violated our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419869793683-Child-Sexual-Abuse-Material-Policy">CSAM Policy</a> are reported to the <a href="https://www.missingkids.org/">National Center for Missing and Exploited Children</a> (NCMEC).</p>
<p>In the first six months of 2023, we banned a total of <strong>19,852 </strong>user accounts for violating our Terms of Service.  This includes accounts that were banned for uploading content that was removed, as well as accounts that were banned for violations not related to content, such as spamming. Additionally, an account may be banned if we identify or are made aware that the account belongs to an individual whose previous account was banned for violating our Terms of Service.  </p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/20448763739027" alt="Picture16.png"></p>
<p><em>The above figure shows the breakdown by ban reason for accounts that were banned in 2023 from January through June.  </em></p>
<p><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> <span style="color: black; background-color: white;">70.37% of accounts were banned for a Community Guidelines violation, while nearly 10% of accounts were banned as they were identified as belonging to an individual whose previous account(s) were banned.  </span></em></p>
<p>The majority of accounts banned during this period were identified by our internal detection methods.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/20448763748115" alt="Picture17.png"></p>
<p><em>The above figure shows a breakdown of banned accounts based on the source of detection. In addition to internal and user-sourced removals, removals due to External Trusted Sources include legal requests and notifications from our </em><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419879221907-Pornhub-Trusted-Flagger-Program"><em>Trusted Flaggers</em></a><em>. </em></p>
<p><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> Of the accounts that were banned in the first six months of 2023, nearly 90% were identified due to internal detection methods, while user notifications accounted for 11.12% of banned accounts.  </em></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>DMCA</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p><span style="color: #111111; background-color: white;">The <em>Digital Millennium Copyright Protection Act</em>, known as the DMCA, is a U.S. law that limits the liability of online service providers for the copyright infringement caused by their users. To qualify, online service providers must do —and not do — certain things. The most well-known aspects of the DMCA are its requirements that a service provider remove materials after it receives a notice of infringement and have (and implement) a policy to deter repeat infringement. Pornhub promptly responds to requests relating to copyright notifications. </span></p>
<p>In addition to blocking uploads of works previously fingerprinted with Mediawise or Safeguard from appearing on Pornhub, during the six month period ended June 30, 2023, we responded to <strong>3,868 </strong>requests for removal, leading to a total of <strong>2,720 </strong>pieces of content removed.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/20448763756691" alt="Picture18.png"></p>
<p><em>The above figure shows the number of requests for removal related to DMCA per month in the first half of 2023. </em></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Cooperation with Law Enforcement</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p>We cooperate with law enforcement globally and readily provide all information available to us upon request and receipt of appropriate documentation and authorization. Legal requests can be submitted by governments and law enforcement, as well as private parties.</p>
<p>In the first half of 2023, we responded to <strong>125 legal requests</strong>. A breakdown by request type as indicated by law enforcement is provided below. </p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/20448763761171" alt="Picture19.png"></p>
<p><em>The above figure displays the number of requests Pornhub received from law enforcement and legal entities in the first six months of 2023 broken down by the type of request as indicated by the requester. </em></p>
<p>As a result of these requests, we classified a total of <strong>14 pieces of content</strong> (all videos) as Terms of Service Violations due to legal requests. A breakdown by removal type is provided below. </p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/20448749590035" alt="Picture20.png"></p>
<p><em>The above figure displays photos and videos that were identified in law enforcement requests that we deemed to violate our Terms of Service upon review.  </em></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Content De-Indexing</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p>As part of our Trust and Safety efforts to remove abusive content not only from our platform, but globally, we request de-indexing of URLs that were removed for violating our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a> from search engines. We proactively seek to de-index all content that is removed for potential CSAM and non-consensual content. In 2023, we added the proactive process for de-indexing content removed for Withdrawal of Consent.</p>
<p>In the first half of 2023, we requested de-indexing of <strong>26,570 </strong>URLs for 20,986 unique pieces of content.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/20448763778195" alt="Picture21.png"></p>
<p class="MsoNoSpacing"><em><span style="font-size: 9.0pt;">The above figure displays a breakdown of the reason for URLs that were de-indexed from search engines. There may be several URLs de-indexed per piece of content, as we request the de-indexing of every version of the URL (e.g. it.pornhub.com/123 would be a URL de-indexed for the content located at www.pornhub.com/123). </span></em></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

            <h1 class="article__title" itemprop="name">
              
              2022 Transparency Report 
            </h1>
            

            <div class="article-meta">
              <div class="article-meta__col article-meta__col--main">
                <div class="entry-info">
                  
                  
                </div>

          <div class="article__body markdown" itemprop="articleBody" data-article="">
            <p>For Pornhub, nothing is more important than the safety of our community. Upholding our Core Values of <strong>consent</strong><strong>, </strong><strong>freedom of sexual expression</strong><strong>, </strong><strong>authenticity</strong><strong>, </strong><strong>originality</strong><strong>, </strong>and <strong>diversity</strong> is only possible through the continual efforts to ensure the safety of our users and our platform. Consequently, we have always been committed to preventing and eliminating illegal content, including non-consensual material and child sexual abuse material (CSAM). Every online platform has the moral responsibility to join this fight, and it requires collective action and constant vigilance.</p>
<p>Over the years, we have put in place robust measures to protect our platform from abuse. We are constantly improving our Trust and Safety policies to better identify, flag, remove, review, and report illegal or abusive material. We are committed to doing all that we can to ensure a safe online experience for our users, which involves a concerted effort to innovate and always striving to do more.</p>
<p>As part of our efforts and dedication to Trust and Safety, we feel it is important to provide information about our Trust and Safety initiatives, technologies, moderation practices and how our platform responds to harmful content. This Transparency Report provides these insights and builds upon our previous reports. Further information can be found in other sections of our Trust and Safety Center, including <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/6017547823763-Pornhub-Literacy">resources</a> about our community, keeping our platform safe, and our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419900587155-About-our-Policies-and-Related-Guidelines">policies</a>.</p>
<p>We are committed to being as transparent as possible and to being a leader in eradicating abusive content from the internet. We will continue to do our part to create a safe space for our users.</p>
<div class="accordion accordion--default">
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Trust and Safety Initiatives and Partnerships - 2022 Update</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p>Our goal to achieve and set the highest level of Trust and Safety standards relies heavily on not only our internal policies and moderation team, but also on our array of external partnerships and technology. The organizations we partner with are part of the global effort to reduce illegal material online and help ensure our platform and adult users can feel safe.</p>
<p>In 2022, we continued to further our Trust and Safety efforts and are proud to have added new partnerships and initiatives. Below is a non-exhaustive list of partnerships and accomplishments achieved in 2022:</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #111111;">The reThink Chatbot </span></strong></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">Building upon our efforts to spread awareness about the harm of child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and to deter users from searching for this kind of content, </span><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/press/show?id=2331">we launched the reThink Chatbot</a><span style="color: #111111;"> in partnership with the </span><a href="https://www.iwf.org.uk/">Internet Watch Foundation</a><span style="color: #111111;"> and </span><a href="https://www.stopitnow.org/">Stop it Now</a><span style="color: #111111;"> in March of 2022. The reThink chatbot engages with Pornhub users attempting to search for sexual imagery of children and signposts them to Stop It Now! UK and Ireland where they can receive help and support to address their behavior. </span></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #111111;">EOKM </span></strong></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">Commissioned by the European Commission and in collaboration with PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), the Centre for </span><a href="https://www.eokm.nl/">Expertise on Online Sexual Child Abuse</a><span style="color: #111111;"> (EOKM) has developed a tool for the faster removal of online child sexual abuse material (CSAM).  </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">The Instant Image Identifier is associated with the three pairs of eyes (3Is) principle, meaning that CSAM images are triple verified in the classification process. Three people (three pairs of eyes) have classified each image. Triple verification is considered as high-quality assessment and the aim is to have all databases triple verified. It lowers the risk of false positives in the hash checking process. </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">We have implemented this tool across all our platforms as another layer of protection for our sites, allowing us to check whether uploaded files occur in datasets of known online child sexual abuse material</span><span style="color: #111111;">. </span></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #111111;">IWF Partnership</span></strong></p>
<p>We recently announced our two-year pilot project in partnership with the <a href="https://www.iwf.org.uk/">Internet Watch Foundation</a> (IWF) to develop a model of good practice to support the adult industry in combatting child sexual abuse material online.</p>
<p>Our industry leading Trust & Safety measures help to keep our platforms and users safe and prevent the upload/re-upload of illegal material. Such measures include mandatory identification for content creators, hash-list scanning, AI tools, human moderation, deterrence messaging, a trusted flagger program, and extensive user reporting options.</p>
<p>We strive to set the gold standard in online safety for user generated content platforms and seek to disseminate this standard to others.</p>
<p>The partnership began in November 2022 and is being overseen by an external advisory board of experts who will guide the outputs of the partnership.</p>
<p>The partnership aims to:</p>
<ul>
<li>Develop a model of good practice to guide the adult industry in combatting child sexual abuse imagery online;</li>
<li>Evaluate the effectiveness of IWF services when deployed across MindGeek’s brands;</li>
<li>Combine technical and engineering expertise to scope and develop solutions which will assist with the detection, disruption and removal of child sexual abuse material online.</li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">The project’s progress will be reviewed at set intervals and reported into the IWF Board. Key learnings from the project will be shared publicly to support others’ work in this area.</span></p>
<span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Additional Partnerships, Tools, and Initiatives</span></span>
<p><strong>Trust and Safety Center</strong></p>
<p>In the spring of 2020, we launched our Trust and Safety Center as part of our ongoing efforts to ensure the safety of our users and to clarify our policies. Our Trust and Safety Center outlines our Core Values and the kind of behavior and content that is—and is not—allowed on the platform. It also highlights important points of our Terms of Service by providing some Related Guidelines, and it shares some of our existing policies with respect to how we tackle violations through prevention, identification, and response.</p>
<p><strong>Trusted Flagger Program</strong></p>
<p>Launched in 2020, our Trusted Flagger Program is now comprised of 49 members spanning over 33 countries, including the <a href="https://www.iwf.org.uk/">Internet Watch Foundation</a> (UK), the <a href="https://cybercivilrights.org/">Cyber Civil Rights Initiative</a> (USA), <a href="https://ecpat.org/">End Child Prostitution and Trafficking</a> (Sweden/Taiwan), and <a href="https://www.pointdecontact.net/">Point de Contact</a> (France). This program allows hotlines, helplines, government agencies, and other trusted organizations to disable content automatically and instantly from Pornhub, without awaiting our internal review. It is a significant step forward in identifying, removing, and reporting harmful and illegal content.</p>
<p><strong>Lucy Faithfull Foundation & Deterrence Messaging</strong></p>
<p>The <a href="https://www.lucyfaithfull.org.uk/">Lucy Faithfull Foundation</a> is a widely respected non-profit organization at the forefront of the fight against child sex abuse, whose crucial efforts include a campaign designed to deter searches seeking or associated with underage content. We have actively worked with Lucy Faithfull to develop deterrence messaging for terms relating to child sexual abuse material (CSAM). As a result, attempts to search for certain words and terms now yield a clear deterrence message about the illegality of underage content, while offering a free, confidential, and anonymous support resource for those interested in seeking help for controlling their urges to engage in illegal behavior. <span style="color: #111111;">In 2022, we partnered with further organizations who offer local resources to change user behavior, including those in Canada, the Czech Republic, and Australia. This takes our total to eight localized versions and one global CSAM deterrence message. We plan to launch further local messages with additional partners in 2023. </span></p>
<p><strong>Deterrence Messaging for Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery </strong></p>
<p>Since the launch of our CSAM deterrence messaging, we have embarked on a similar initiative for non-consensual material. This concerns searches for content where there is a lack of consent to sexual acts, the recording or distribution of the content, or manipulation of one’s image, commonly known as “deepfakes”. If users search for terms relating to non-consensual material, they are reminded that such material may be illegal. As part of the messaging, resources are provided for removal of non-consensual material and support for victims via our NGO partners. In 2022 we added <a href="https://www.permessonegato.it/">Permesso Negato</a>, an NGO based in Italy, providing support to victims across the EU.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.activefence.com/"><strong><span style="color: windowtext;">ActiveFence</span></strong></a></p>
<p>To expand on our efforts in identifying and responding to safety risks on Pornhub, we partnered with <a href="https://www.activefence.com/">ActiveFence</a>, a leading technology solution for Trust and Safety teams working to protect their online integrity and keep users safe. ActiveFence helps Pornhub combat abusive content by identifying bad actors, content that violates our platform’s policies, and mentions of the use of Pornhub for illegal or suspicious activity.</p>
<p><strong>Spectrum Labs AI </strong></p>
<p><span style="color: #201f1e; background-color: white;">We have been working with </span><a href="https://www.spectrumlabsai.com/">Spectrum Labs AI</a><span style="color: #201f1e; background-color: white;"> to proactively surface and remove harmful text on our platforms. This drives productivity and accuracy of our internal moderation teams and tooling.</span></p>
<p><strong>Yoti – Third-Party Identity Documentation Validation</strong></p>
<p>Yoti is our trusted, third-party identity verification and documentation validation service provider. Yoti verifies the identity of users who apply to become verified uploaders before they can upload any content to our platform.</p>
<p>Trusted by governments and regulators around the world, as well as a wide range of commercial industries, Yoti deploys a combination of state-of-the-art AI technology, liveness anti-spoofing, and document authenticity checks to thoroughly verify the age and identity of any user. Yoti technology can handle millions of scans per day with over 240 million age scans performed in 2019. Yoti has received certification from the British Board of Film Classification’s age verification program and from the Age Check Certification Scheme, a United Kingdom Accreditation Service.</p>
<p>Users who verify their age with Yoti can trust that their personal data remains secure. Yoti is certified to meet the requirements of ISO/IEC 27001, which is the global gold standard for information security management. This means that Yoti’s security aligns with Pornhub’s commitment to protecting our users’ privacy as well. You can learn more about how Yoti works <a href="https://www.yoti.com/">here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Corporate Responsibility </strong></p>
<p>Pornhub Cares is a philanthropic endeavor focused on furthering the charitable contributions of Pornhub as a whole. Over the years we have worked with and donated to well-recognized and respected organizations such as People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA), the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP), the Center for Honeybee Research, Movember, and more, leveraging our 130 million daily visitors to increase awareness and donate funds to some very important causes. We also remain focused on establishing ongoing partnerships that support efforts within the sex work community, such as those we have with SWOP and Pineapple Support.</p>
<p>The Pornhub Sexual Wellness Center (SWC) was launched in 2017 under the direction of esteemed sex therapist Dr. Laurie Betito as an online resource aiming to provide our audience with information and advice regarding sexuality, sexual health, and relationships. The SWC furthers Pornhub’s commitment to conveying unequivocally that pornography should NOT be a replacement for proper sex education—and that sex in porn is very different from sex in real life! The SWC features original editorial and video content on an assortment of topics from a diverse array of doctors, therapists, community leaders and experts.</p>
<p><strong>Cutting-Edge Automated Detection Technology</strong></p>
<p>Pornhub deploys several different automated detection technologies to help moderate content before it can be published, including:</p>
<p><strong>CSAI Match</strong> – YouTube’s proprietary technology for combating child sexual abuse imagery. All video content appearing on Pornhub has been scanned against <a href="https://www.youtube.com/csai-match/">YouTube’s CSAI Match</a>. All new video content is scanned at the time of upload and before it can be published.</p>
<p><strong>PhotoDNA </strong>– Microsoft’s technology that aids in finding and removing known images of child sexual abuse material. All photo content appearing on Pornhub has been scanned against <a href="https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/photodna">Microsoft’s PhotoDNA</a>. All new photo content is scanned at the time of upload and before it can be published.</p>
<p><strong>Google's Content Safety API</strong> – <a href="https://protectingchildren.google/intl/en/">Google’s Content Safety API</a> uses artificial intelligence to help companies better prioritize abuse material for review. The API steps up the fight for child safety by prioritizing potentially illegal content for human review and helping reviewers find and report content faster.</p>
<p><strong>MediaWise</strong> – <a href="https://www.vobilegroup.com/">Vobile</a>’s cyber “fingerprinting” software that scans all new user uploads to help prevent previously identified content from being re-uploaded.</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #212121;">Safer </span></strong><span style="color: #212121;">– In November 2020, we became the first adult content platform to partner with </span><a href="https://www.thorn.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Thorn</a><span style="color: #212121;">, allowing us to begin using its </span><a href="https://safer.io/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Safer</a><span style="color: #212121;"> product on Pornhub, adding an additional layer of protection in our robust compliance and content moderation process. Safer joins the list of technologies that Pornhub utilizes to help protect visitors from unwanted or illegal material.</span></p>
<p><strong>Instant Image Identifier</strong> – The <span style="color: #111111;">Centre for Expertise on Online Sexual Child Abuse (</span><a href="https://www.eokm.nl/">EOKM</a><span style="color: #111111;">)</span> tool, commissioned by the European Commission, detects known child abuse imagery using a triple verified database.</p>
<p><strong>Safeguard</strong> – Safeguard is Pornhub’s proprietary image recognition technology designed with the purpose of combatting both child sexual abuse imagery and non-consensual content, by preventing the re-uploading of previously fingerprinted content to our platform.</p>
<p><strong>Age Estimation</strong> – We also utilize age estimation capabilities to analyze content uploaded to our platform using a combination of internal proprietary software and <a href="https://azure.microsoft.com/en-ca/services/cognitive-services/face/#overview">Microsoft Azure Face API</a> in an effort to strengthen the varying methods we use to prevent the upload and publication of potential or actual CSAM.</p>
<p>Pornhub remains vigilant when it comes to researching, adopting, and using the latest and best available detection technology to help make it a safe platform, while remaining an inclusive, sex positive online space for adults.</p>
</div>

<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Content Removals</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p class="MsoNormal">A total of <strong>3.8 million</strong> (2,182,313 videos and 1,632,654 photos) pieces of content were uploaded to Pornhub in 2022. Of these uploads, <strong>58,509</strong> (52,028 videos and 6,481 photos) were blocked at upload or removed for violating our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a>.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">An additional 98,910 pieces of content (37,505 videos and 61,405 photos) uploaded prior to 2022 were labeled as Terms of Service violations, for a total of <strong>157,419</strong> pieces of content (89,533 videos and 67,886 photos) removed during 2022 for violations of our Terms of Service.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><img src="/hc/article_attachments/14666598272915" alt="1.png"></p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><em><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; line-height: 107%;">The above figure provides a breakdown of content uploaded <strong>and</strong> removed in 2022 by removal reason. For additional information and explanations of each removal reason, please see below. </span></em></p>
<h3><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Non-Consensual Content (NCC) </span></span></h3>
<p>In 2022, we removed <strong>13,321 </strong>pieces of content (8,730 videos and 4,591 photos) for violating our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419871787027-Non-Consensual-Content-Policy">NCC policy</a>. When we identify or are made aware of the existence of non-consensual content on Pornhub, we remove the content, fingerprint it to prevent re-upload, and ban the user where appropriate. </p>
<p>Our NCC policy includes the following violations:</p>
<ul>
<li>Non-Consensual Content – Act(s): Content which depicts activity for which an individual did not validly consent. A non-consensual act is one involving the application of force directly or indirectly without the consent of the other person to a sexual act. </li>
<li>Non-Consensual Content – Recording(s): The recording of sexually explicit activity without the consent of the featured person. </li>
<li>Non-Consensual Content – Distribution: The distribution of sexually explicit content without the featured person’s permission. </li>
<li>Non-Consensual Content – Manipulation: Also known as “deepfake,” this type of content appropriates a real person’s likeness without their consent. </li>
</ul>
<h3><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Potential Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) </span></span></h3>
<p>We have a <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419869793683-Child-Sexual-Abuse-Material-Policy">zero-tolerance policy</a> toward any content that features a person (real or animated) that is under the age of 18. Through our use of cutting-edge CSAM detection technology, age and identity verification measures, as well as human moderators, we strive to quickly identify and remove potential CSAM and ban users who have uploaded this content. Any content that we identify as or are made aware of being potential CSAM is also fingerprinted to prevent re-upload upon removal. We report all instances of potential CSAM to the <a href="https://www.missingkids.org/">National Center for Missing and Exploited Children</a> (NCMEC).</p>
<p>In 2022, we made <strong>1,996 </strong>reports to NCMEC. These reports contained 9,588 pieces of content (3,604 videos and 5,984 photos) which were reported for violating our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419869793683-Child-Sexual-Abuse-Material-Policy">CSAM Policy</a>.</p>
<h3><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">General Violations of Terms of Service</span></span></h3>
<p>In 2022, we removed <strong>123,216 </strong>pieces of content (68,548 videos and 54,668 photos) for general violations of our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a>. When we identify or are made aware of the existence of content that violates our Terms of Service on Pornhub, we remove the content, fingerprint it to prevent re-upload, and, where appropriate, may ban the user. </p>
<p>A portion of these removals is related to requests from individuals who previously consented to the distribution of content they appear in but have submitted a request to retract that consent. Uploaders whose content is removed upon an individual retracting their consent for the content to be distributed are not subject to banning as per our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419871787027-Non-Consensual-Content-Policy">NCC policy</a>.  Individuals who wish to retract their consent may reach out to us via our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/content-removal">Content Removal Request</a> form.</p>
<p>Content may be removed for general violations of our Terms of Service, outside of any of the other reasons listed, for being objectionable or inappropriate for our platform. This also includes violations related to brand safety, defamation, and the use of our platform for sexual services.</p>
<h3><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Other Reasons for Removal</span></span></h3>
<p><strong>Hate Speech </strong></p>
<p>We do not allow abusive or <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/14512634908819-Hate-Speech-Policy">hateful content</a> or comments of a racist, homophobic, transphobic, or otherwise derogatory nature intended to hurt or shame those individuals featured.</p>
<p>In 2022, we removed <strong>259 </strong>pieces of content (41 videos and 218 photos) for violating our hate speech and violent speech policy.   </p>
<p><strong>Animal Guidelines</strong></p>
<p>Content that shows or promotes <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/7906741373971-Animal-Welfare-Policy">harmful activity to animals</a>, including exploiting an animal for sexual gratification, physical or psychological abuse of animals, is prohibited on our platform.</p>
<p>In 2022, we removed <strong>776 </strong>pieces of content (310 videos and 466 photos) for violating our Animal Guidelines.   </p>
<p><strong>Bodily Fluids </strong></p>
<p>Content depicting blood, vomit, or feces, among others, is not permitted on Pornhub.</p>
<p>In 2022, we removed <strong>4,616 </strong>pieces of content (3,802 videos and 814 photos) for violating our policy related to excretion of bodily fluids.   </p>
<p><strong>Familial Relations </strong></p>
<p>We do not allow any content which depicts incest.</p>
<p>In 2022, we removed <strong>4,282 </strong>pieces of content (3,503 videos and 779 photos) for violating our policy related to familial relations.  </p>
<p><strong>Bodily Harm </strong></p>
<p>We prohibit excessive use of force that poses a risk of serious physical harm to any person appearing in the content or any physical or sexual activity with a corpse. This violation does not include forced sexual acts, as this content would fall under our non-consensual policy. </p>
<p>In 2022, we removed <strong>1,361 </strong>pieces of content (995 videos and 366 photos) for violating our bodily harm and violent content policy.   </p>
<h3><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Removed Video Views</span></span></h3>
<p>Given additional uploader verification measures introduced in late 2020 and ongoing enhancements of moderation processes, we feel that it is important to evaluate the impact that these efforts have had in preventing and responding to abuse on our platform. An ongoing goal of our moderation efforts is to identify as much unwanted content as possible at the time of upload before appearing live on Pornhub.</p>
<p>Videos uploaded in 2022 that were removed for violating our Terms of Service accounted for 0.74% of total views of videos uploaded in 2022.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/14666598202003" alt="2.png"></p>

<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small"><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> <span style="color: black; background-color: white;">Nearly three quarters of removed videos were identified and removed by our human moderators or internal detection tools before going live on our platform. </span></em></span></p>
<p> </p>

<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Moderation and Content Removal Process</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<h3><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Upload and Moderation Process</span></span></h3>
<p>As Pornhub strives to prevent abuse on our platform, <strong>all </strong>content is reviewed upon upload by our trained staff of moderators before it is ever made live on our site. Uploads are also automatically scanned against several external automated detection technologies as well as our internal tool for fingerprinting and identifying violative content, Safeguard. Furthermore, only verified users can upload content to our platform, after passing verification measures through Yoti.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/15027111625235" alt="Moderation_Updated.PNG"></p>
<h3><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Content Removal Process</span></span></h3>
<p>Users may alert us to content that may be illegal or otherwise violates our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a> by using the flagging feature or by filling out our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/content-removal">Content Removal Request</a> form. </p>
<p>While users can notify us of potentially abusive content, we also invest a great deal into internal detection, which includes technology and a 24/7 team of moderators, who can detect content that may violate our Terms of Service at time of upload and before it is published. Most of this unwanted content is discovered via our internal detection methods.</p>
<p><img src="/hc/article_attachments/14666638753427" alt="4.png"></p>
<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small"><em>The above figure shows a breakdown of removals based on the source of detection. In addition to internal and user-sourced removals, removals due to External Trusted Sources include legal requests and notifications from our </em><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419879221907-Pornhub-Trusted-Flagger-Program"><em>Trusted Flaggers</em></a><em>. </em></span></p>
<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small"><strong><em>Analysis:</em></strong><em> Of all the content that was removed for a TOS violation in 2022, 73.21% of content was identified via Pornhub’s internal methods of moderation, compared to 25.84% of content being alerted to our team from our users.</em> </span></p>
<p>As we add technologies and new moderation practices, our goal is to ensure that our moderation team is identifying as much violative content as possible before it is published. This is paramount to combatting abusive material and for creating a safe environment for our users. From content uploaded in 2022, 82.60% of removals were the result of Pornhub’s internal detection methods.<em>  </em></p>
